_comment: Phase 2.5 benchmark suite -- checked-in, tracked (not CI-gating) TS-vs-Python
baseline comparison (planning/ifcopenshell-ts/20-roadmap.md's 'Phase 2.5 -- Alpha
checkpoint': 'record a one-time ratio (TS time / Python time) ... visible and
tracked rather than a hard gate').
How to (re)populate the 'ts' section: run the real CI 'benchmark' job (Linux x64,
see .github/workflows/ci-ifcopenshell-ts.yml) or `npm run bench` locally against a
real built addon, then copy the relevant numbers out of the resulting
bench-results.json (gitignored -- either the CI job's uploaded artifact, or the
file `npm run bench` writes to the package root locally) into 'ts' below:
attributeAccessCachedMs   <- the 'attributeAccess.cachedVsUncached' entry's cachedMs
attributeAccessUncachedMs <- the 'attributeAccess.cachedVsUncached' entry's uncachedMs
getInfoMs                 <- the 'getInfo.bulkRecursive' entry's durationMs
fileOpenSyncMs            <- the 'fileOpen.sync' entry's durationMs
wallCount                 <- any entry's wallCount (should agree; 60000 as of this PR)
How to (re)populate the 'python' section and 'ratios': run
`python3 tools/bench_python_baseline.py` from a Python environment with
ifcopenshell-python built/importable (see that script's own header comment for
the exact requirements) -- it fills in 'python' from a fresh measurement and
recomputes 'ratios' from whatever 'ts' section is already here, so populate 'ts'
first for 'ratios' to come out non-null.
Disclosed gap as of this PR: the sandbox this PR was authored in has neither a
working C++ toolchain (no cmake/Boost -- can't build the real addon to run
`npm run bench`) nor network access to PyPI/a built ifcopenshell-python (can't run
tools/bench_python_baseline.py either) -- see that script's own header comment and
this PR's final report for the full detail. 'ts'/'python'/'ratios' below are
therefore still unpopulated placeholders; a maintainer needs to run the real CI
'benchmark' job at least once and this script at least once to fill them in.
